proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 1,000,000 free tokens per month via simple HTTP header authentication.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Converts any URL (including JS-heavy dynamic pages) into clean, LLM-friendly Markdown. Bypassess standard cloud scraping blocks effortlessly.
proposals.would_integrate_where: GitHub Actions trend-hunting pipelines (`agent_trendhunter` / `agent_opportunity_hunter`). Allows scraping e-commerce bestseller lists directly into Gemini 2.5 Flash without headless browser overhead.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Subject to rate limits if burst-called; some highly protected sites (like Amazon) might require custom headers or premium proxies.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: No monthly fee. 5% + $0.50 per transaction fee. Unlimited products, hosting, and bandwidth.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Acts as a Merchant of Record (MoR). They automatically calculate, collect, and remit EU VAT (crucial for Hugo in France) and global sales taxes, removing 100% of accounting overhead for digital files.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Direct sale of consolidated asset bundles (STL packs, gamedev assets, PDF book compilations) compiled by GitHub Actions and hosted/delivered automatically.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Payouts require reaching a minimum threshold; strict policy against copyright-infringing content.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Free to list. Epic Games takes a 12% revenue share (you keep 88%). No upfront fees.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Unified successor to Unreal Engine Marketplace, Sketchfab, and Quixel. Massive built-in audience of game developers looking for 3D models, 2D textures, and UI assets.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Pipeline `produce_gamedev_asset_pack` or `produce_stl_parametric` to auto-package and target gamedevs alongside itch.io.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: High quality standards. Manual review process for first-time sellers can take several days.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Generous daily free 'energy' tokens (~50-100 runs per day depending on the model used).
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Allows building and calling micro-workflows (combining LLMs, ControlNet, FLUX, and SDXL) via a single API call. Excellent for specialized styling (e.g., turning sketches into clean vector-like line art).
proposals.would_integrate_where: Pipeline `produce_coloring_book` or `produce_svg_pack` to generate clean, high-contrast black and white vector-like assets directly from text prompts.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Public runs on the free tier can be visible on their community feed; API schema changes occasionally.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Free to list digital files. Optional membership program with 15% platform fee for paid downloads.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: A rapidly growing 3D model search engine and community marketplace. Features geometric search, making it easier for custom OpenSCAD/STL designs to be discovered organically than on Cults3D.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Pipeline `produce_stl_openscad` and `produce_stl_parametric`. Direct upload of generated STL configurations.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Heavily focused on functional and pop-culture 3D printing; pure artistic models have lower conversion rates.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 100% free open-source model. Zero-cost usage when run via public Hugging Face Spaces API endpoints.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: An incredibly lightweight (82M parameters) text-to-speech model that rivals ElevenLabs in quality and emotional inflection, but can be run completely free and fast.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Creating audio companions for KDP children's books or sound effects/narrations for game assets (`produce_mobile_game_scaffold`).
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Requires Python integration to tap into Gradio/HF Space endpoints, which can occasionally go sleeping if inactive (requires a wake-up ping).

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 2,500 free Google Search queries upon sign-up (no credit card required).
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Provides lightning-fast, structured JSON search results from Google, including 'People Also Ask' questions and shopping results. Far more reliable than scraping Google raw.
proposals.would_integrate_where: The niche analysis phase (`agent_niche_gap` / `agent_eclaireur_bestsellers`) to discover low-competition search terms and trends programmatically.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Once the 2,500 free queries are exhausted, requires manual creation of a new free account or transitioning to their very cheap pay-as-you-go pricing ($1 per 1,000 queries).
